card.name: Benefits after "The risks and"
card.fires_on: The word "benefits" right after "the risks and" in warning text, usually at the start of a sentence like "The risks and benefits of treatment should be considered".

modes.label: Risks and benefits sentence
modes.description: "benefits" completes the phrase "risks and benefits" before "of treatment" or a drug name, usually after an infection warning.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward "before", as in "should be considered before initiating".
card.plain: It marks the word "benefits" in "risks and benefits", where the text usually goes on to say "consider before starting treatment".
